name: scanx-mern
description: ScanX — MERN consulting website (React + Express + MongoDB)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: node api.js && concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: node api.js && npm run build --prefix client
